title: Modestiary
description: Araxer Bestiary compat with multiple modded mobs
body:
Modestiary is a compability Datapack for [Araxer's Bestiary](https://modrinth.com/mod/araxers-bestiary) that aims to add a more in depth compability with various modded mobs.

Current features that this datapack brings are:
- Description for each mobs, giving a clue of what they do, and interaction that player can do with them.
- Spawning, which also include unique spawn system like structure, summons, hatched, etc.
- Loot Tables, including unique drop system for certain mobs.

Note: _**Errors such as mob not being shown on dictionary or mob model being glitchy are gonna be related to the base mod or compatible mod instead, as this datapack only adding informations and descriptions.**_



Current Compatible Mod:
- [Mowzie's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/mowzies-mobs)
- [Opposing Force](https://modrinth.com/mod/opposing-force)
- [Species](https://modrinth.com/mod/species)
- [Whaleborne](https://modrinth.com/mod/whaleborne)
- [Savage & Ravage](https://modrinth.com/mod/savage-and-ravage)
- [Caverns & Chasms](https://modrinth.com/mod/caverns-and-chasms)
- [Jaden's Nether Expansions](https://modrinth.com/mod/jadens-nether-expansion)
- [Sully's Mods](https://modrinth.com/mod/sullysmod)
- [Wan's Ancient Beasts](https://modrinth.com/mod/wab)

Thanks a lot for Araxer for creating such a cool guide mod and all the modders who's giving permission to make a datapack for it!!
